title:
Transform the grid cell icon coloring to be based on column field and a series of corresponding field names, and configs.
This transform accepts a json object as input with the following properties:
columnFields {Array} - Indicates where to locate grid data within the component.
series {Array} - Contains objects defining field names and corresponding configurations.
  Each object in the series should have:
    - fieldName {string}: The field in the grid data to which icon coloring applies.
    - config {object}: Configuration specifying the icon color settings for the field.
name: ConfigurableGridIconColorTransform
